yunxiao.diagnosis.succeeded.evidence: API 15621 requires scalar diagnosisID and documents 检测成功, 检测失败, 检测部分成功, 检测终止 and 检测中. Partial success does not satisfy complete diagnostic success; preserve the documented Chinese wire values.

yunxiao.node.locked.evidence: API 14139 accepts one scalar node ID and returns id plus documented Boolean isLocked. The ID becomes required for exact selection. No failure state is documented; no general node readiness is inferred from this lock flag.

yunxiao.node.unlocked.evidence: API 14139 accepts one scalar node ID and returns id plus documented Boolean isLocked. The ID becomes required for exact selection. No failure state is documented; no general node readiness is inferred from this lock flag.

yunxiao.script.succeeded.evidence: API 18006 has an optional scalar invokeCommandID which becomes required for exact collection selection. Its overall status includes success, failed and partialFailed; individual node success cannot establish overall success.

yunxiao.task.execution.running.evidence: API 15922 requires a task execution ID and workspace ID, and documents 4 running, 6 succeeded, 7 failed, 9 stopped, 10 abnormal. Creation, queueing, restarting and stopping remain pending. Ended executions cannot satisfy a running wait.

yunxiao.task.execution.stopped.evidence: API 15922 requires a task execution ID and workspace ID, and documents 4 running, 6 succeeded, 7 failed, 9 stopped, 10 abnormal. Creation, queueing, restarting and stopping remain pending. Ended executions cannot satisfy a running wait.

yunxiao.task.execution.succeeded.evidence: API 15922 requires a task execution ID and workspace ID, and documents 4 running, 6 succeeded, 7 failed, 9 stopped, 10 abnormal. Creation, queueing, restarting and stopping remain pending. Ended executions cannot satisfy a running wait.
